annotations.title: Web research: search and read the top pages

description: One call to research a question on the web: a Brave web search, then the text of the top 1-5 result pages, read in parallel and clipped to your length, with titles and URLs. A page that cannot be read is listed with its reason. Results are for the caller's immediate use only: no storing, resale or model training (Brave API terms). Use when an agent needs current, sourced information in one step instead of a search plus several page reads. Example: q=x402 payment protocol. Price $0.03/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

maxChars.description: Characters of text per page (500-10000, default 3000)

pages.description: How many top results to read in full (1-5, default 3)

q.description: What to research, at most 400 characters
